Entries.Title: TV5
Entries.Description: TV5 is a major Philippine television network offering a mix of local and international programming, including news, entertainment, and sports.

Entries.Title: A2Z (ABS-CBN)
Entries.Description: A2Z is a Philippine free-to-air blocktime broadcast television network based in Quezon City, with its studios located in Ortigas Center, Pasig. It serves as a flagship property of ZOE Broadcasting Network, the broadcast media arm of Jesus Is Lord Church Worldwide, in partnership with ABS-CBN Corporation as its main content provider through a blocktime agreement.

Entries.Title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba — Infinity Castle
Entries.Description: As the Demon Slayer Corps members and Hashira engaged in a group strength training program, the Hashira Training, in preparation for the forthcoming battle against the demons, Muzan Kibutsuji appears at the Ubuyashiki Mansion. With the head of the Demon Corps in danger, Tanjiro and the Hashira rush to the headquarters but are plunged into a deep descent to a mysterious space by the hands of Muzan Kibutsuji.  The destination of where Tanjiro and Demon Slayer Corps have fallen is the demons' stronghold – the Infinity Castle. And so, the battleground is set as the final battle between the Demon Slayer Corps and the demons ignites.

Entries.Title: Ne Zha 2
Entries.Description: After a catastrophic event leaves their bodies destroyed, Ne Zha and Ao Bing are granted a fragile second chance at life. As tensions rise between the dragon clans and celestial forces, the two must undergo a series of perilous trials that will test their bond, challenge their identities, and decide the fate of both mortals and immortals.

Entries.Title: KPop Demon Hunters
Entries.Description: When K-pop superstars Rumi, Mira and Zoey aren't selling out stadiums, they're using their secret powers to protect their fans from supernatural threats.

Entries.Title: The Bad Guys 2
Entries.Description: The now-reformed Bad Guys are trying (very, very hard) to be good, but instead find themselves hijacked into a high-stakes, globe-trotting heist, masterminded by a new team of criminals they never saw coming: The Bad Girls.

Entries.Title: Kaiju No. 8: Mission Recon
Entries.Description: In a Kaiju-filled Japan, Kafka Hibino works in monster disposal. After reuniting with his childhood friend Mina Ashiro, a rising star in the anti-Kaiju Defense Force, he decides to pursue his abandoned dream of joining the Force, when he suddenly transforms into the powerful "Kaiju No. 8." An action-packed recap of the first season of Kaiju No. 8 and a new original episode, Hoshina's Day Off.

Entries.Title: Predator: Killer of Killers
Entries.Description: While three of the fiercest warriors in human history—a Viking raider, a ninja in feudal Japan, and a WWII pilot—are killers in their own right, they are merely prey for their new opponent: the ultimate killer of killers.

Entries.Title: Kayara
Entries.Description: A courageous and athletic teenager, Kayara dreams that she is destined to be the first female to break into the league of Chasquis - the official messengers of the Incan empire. As she learns what it takes to be a Chasqui along with its challenges, she tackles every mission she gets and discovers the ancient stories of her land and her people.

Entries.Title: Smurfs
Entries.Description: When Papa Smurf is mysteriously taken by evil wizards, Razamel and Gargamel, Smurfette leads the Smurfs on a mission into the real world to save him. With the help of new friends, the Smurfs must discover what defines their destiny to save the universe.

Entries.Title: Sneaks
Entries.Description: Ty, a misguided, one-of-a-kind designer sneaker, doesn’t know life outside the comforts of his velvet-lined shoebox. After his sister is stolen by a shady collector, Ty must venture into New York City to find and rescue her. In his adventure, Ty meets a ragtag group of footwear friends from all walks of life who help him find the courage to step outside of his shoebox and find his sole-mate.

Entries.Title: Elio
Entries.Description: Elio, a space fanatic with an active imagination, finds himself on a cosmic misadventure where he must form new bonds with eccentric alien lifeforms, navigate a crisis of intergalactic proportions and somehow discover who he is truly meant to be.

Entries.Title: Snow White
Entries.Description: When the Queen’s jealousy turns deadly, Snow White must join forces with gnomes to fight back against her stepmother’s wrath.

Entries.Title: Pleasant  Goat and Big Big Wolf: Bright New Dawn
Entries.Description: The Mighty Little Defenders receive an urgent call for help from the Land of Light and set out without hesitation on a perilous rescue mission, facing hidden conspiracies and powerful foes. Can the goats and wolves break through the darkness and restore the light? What fate awaits the Land of Light… The final battle between light and darkness is about to begin.

Entries.Title: Spermageddon
Entries.Description: Two narrative threads - one is an emerging love story between two awkward teens, Jens and Lisa, who are having sex for the first time and the other is an eventful quest of Simon the Semen and his friends to reach the golden goal, the Egg.

Entries.Title: Zootopia 2
Entries.Description: After cracking the biggest case in Zootopia's history, rookie cops Judy Hopps and Nick Wilde find their partnership isn't as solid as they thought when Chief Bogo orders them to join the Partners in Crisis counseling program. But it doesn't take long for their partnership to be put to the ultimate test when they find themselves on the twisting trail of a mystery tied to the arrival of a venomous snake in the animal metropolis.

Entries.Title: The Legend of Hei 2
Entries.Description: When an attack shatters the fragile peace between the spirit world and humanity, Hei teams up with Luye, the last disciple of his Shifu Wuxian, to expose a conspiracy that threatens both realms - and the bond they've sworn to protect.

Entries.Title: Batman Ninja vs. Yakuza League
Entries.Description: The Batman family has returned to the present to discover that Japan has disappeared, and a giant island - Hinomoto - is now in the sky over Gotham City.  At the top sit the Yakuza, a group of superpowered individuals who reign without honor or humanity and look suspiciously like the Justice League. Now, it’s up to Batman and his allies to save Gotham!

Entries.Title: Dog Man
Entries.Description: When a faithful police dog and his human police officer owner are injured together on the job, a harebrained but life-saving surgery fuses the two of them together and Dog Man is born. Dog Man is sworn to protect and serve—and fetch, sit and roll over. As Dog Man embraces his new identity and strives to impress his Chief, he must stop the pretty evil plots of feline supervillain Petey the Cat.

Entries.Title: Plankton: The Movie
Entries.Description: Plankton's tangled love story with his sentient computer wife goes sideways when she takes a stand — and decides to destroy the world without him.

Entries.Title: JUJUTSU KAISEN: Hidden Inventory / Premature Death - The Movie
Entries.Description: Pursued by a religious cult and other curse users, former friends Satoru Gojo and Suguru Geto are the only sorcerers capable of carrying the difficult task of protecting Riko Amanai, a student who has been designated to be sacrificed as the Star Plasma Vessel, until she can fulfill her duty.

Entries.Title: Hola Frida!
Entries.Description: It’s the story of a little girl who is different. Her world is Coyoacan, Mexico City. Sparkling, vibrant, everything interests her and when difficulties arise, she faces them with an overflowing imagination. This little girl is called Frida Kahlo.

Entries.Title: Kiff Lore of the Ring Light
Entries.Description: Kiff and her friends go on an adventure to destroy a ring light of immense power.

Entries.Title: Mahavatar Narsimha
Entries.Description: Hiranyakashyap, the tyrannical demon, challenges Vishnu, proclaiming himself a god. However, his son Prahlad remains devoted to Vishnu, who appears as Narsimha to defeat the demon.

Entries.Title: Detective Conan: One-Eyed Flashback
Entries.Description: As police inspector Yamato Kansuke pursues a certain man in the snowy mountains of Nagano, a shadow suddenly appears in his field of vision. While he's distracted, a rifle bullet fired by someone grazes his left eye and causes an avalanche accompanied by a roar. Ten months later, Kansuke, having miraculously survived the avalanche, receives a report that a researcher at the Nobeyama National Astronomical Observatory has been attacked.

Entries.Title: A Love Too Captivating
Entries.Description: Misuzu was branded a delinquent when a small incident left him isolated. But one day, he sees the top student, Kitahara, get surrounded by bullies and decides to help him out. That sparked Kitahara's interest in the lonely boy, but Misuzu pushes Kitahara away. "If you get involved with me, you'll get ostracized by everyone else too." But it won't take long for Misuzu's resolve to falter...

Entries.Title: Endless Journey of Love
Entries.Description: In 1930s China, village girl Qian Xiao gains the power to control time, making her a target of powerful forces. As she uncovers the metropolis's hidden secrets, she faces peril and the cost of her gift.

Entries.Title: Lost in Starlight
Entries.Description: When an astronaut leaves Earth for Mars, the vast infinite space divides star-crossed lovers in this animated romance that crosses the cosmos.

Entries.Title: The King of Kings
Entries.Description: Charles Dickens tells his young son Walter the greatest story ever told, and what begins as a bedtime tale becomes a life-changing journey. Through vivid imagination, the boy walks alongside Jesus, witnessing His miracles, facing His trials, and understanding His ultimate sacrifice.

Entries.Title: The Bad Guys: Little Lies and Alibis
Entries.Description: A group of former criminals do their best to get to their parole interview on time.

Entries.Title: Norbert
Entries.Description: Norbert an incompetent spy from a sad, bureaucratic and grey nation will become a key player to thwart the plans of his own government, in an exciting quest that will see him travel alongside strange companions.

Entries.Title: Douluo Dalu Movie: Sword of Dust
Entries.Description: Two decades before Douluo's final clash, the Soul Temple schemed to conquer the soul master realm, targeting the Seven-Treasure Glazed Sect first. Gu Douluo begged swordmaster Chen Xin to protect 5-year-old heir Ning Rongrong, unknowingly triggering a life-or-death flight that unraveled a continent-shaking conspiracy in shadows.

Entries.Title: The Witcher: Sirens of the Deep
Entries.Description: Geralt of Rivia, a mutated monster hunter, is hired to investigate a series of attacks in a seaside village and finds himself drawn into a centuries-old conflict between humans and merpeople. He must count on friends — old and new — to solve the mystery before the hostilities between the two kingdoms escalate into an all-out war.

Entries.Title: Lulu Is a Rhinoceros
Entries.Description: On a quest to spread kindness, fun-loving Lulu embarks on the adventure of a lifetime, powered by new friends, courage, and catchy songs!

Entries.Title: The SpongeBob Movie: Search for SquarePants
Entries.Description: SpongeBob travels to the depths of the ocean and faces off against the ghost of the Flying Dutchman.

Entries.Title: Nobody
Entries.Description: The Little Pig Yao decides to leave Langlang Mountain to join the pilgrimage. On the journey west, what trials will the little monsters face? In the end, will they achieve their dreams and live as they truly desire?

Entries.Title: Love Me
Entries.Description: In a story that spans billions of years, a buoy and a satellite meet online long after humanity’s extinction. As they learn what life was like on Earth, they discover themselves and what it means to be alive and in love.

Entries.Title: Fixed
Entries.Description: After learning he's getting neutered, a dog has 24 hours to squeeze in one last balls-to-the-wall adventure with the boys.

Entries.Title: Chainsaw Man - The Movie: Reze Arc
Entries.Description: In a brutal war between devils, hunters, and secret enemies, a mysterious girl named Reze has stepped into Denji's world, and he faces his deadliest battle yet, fueled by love in a world where survival knows no rules.

Entries.Title: Cocoon: Aru Natsu no Shoujo-tachi yori
Entries.Description: San and Mayu are two schoolgirls living in Okinawa during the closing months of the Pacific War. Together with their classmates, the two friends are drafted into the war effort as nurses for wounded soldiers. When ordered to die for their country, the remaining members of the group escape only to face the harsh environment of a tropical paradise that has become a hellish battlefield.

Entries.Title: COLORFUL STAGE! The Movie: A Miku Who Can't Sing
Entries.Description: Ichika is a high school musician who can enter a mysterious place called “SEKAI,” where she and her friends express their innermost emotions through music alongside Hatsune Miku. One day after giving a live performance, Ichika meets a new Miku that she has never seen before. No matter how hard this new Miku tries to sing, she struggles connecting with the hearts of her listeners. Miku must rely on the help of others to find a way to sing again.

Entries.Title: Curious Tales of a Temple
Entries.Description: An epic animated fantasy anthology film intertwining six storylines from China's classic supernatural story collection "Strange Tales from a Chinese Studio" by Pu Songling. The six stories center on Lanruo Temple, an ancient ruin haunted by spirits. Weaving in classic tales like "Taoist from Laoshan Mountain," "Princess Lotus," "Nie Xiaoqian," "The Painted Skin" and "The Daughter of Magistrate Lu." These stories — spanning humans, ghosts and demons — explore love, death and morality against shifting time. The film merges six distinct styles into one anthology. For example, "Taoist from Laoshan Mountain" uses felt-textured animation, while "The Painted Skin" mirrors Song dynasty painting aesthetics.

Entries.Title: Kalakal
Entries.Description: A seductive female garbage collector who embraces the life of an escort lady. Desperate to live a comfortable life, she leaves the dumpsite and enters the club. But can she also dump both her brother and her lover who remind her of her past?

Entries.Title: Shake, Rattle and Roll 12
Entries.Description: The first episode "Mamanyiika" plays on the words "mama" and "manyika" which literally means "mother doll". The story of a possessed doll. The second episode, is the tale of three girls, one of them the apple of the eye of a terrible engkanto, who then captures the girl. Punerarya the third story, is a story of a tutor teaching the children of the ghoul entrepreneurs of a funeral parlor.

Entries.Title: Nukitashi the Animation
Entries.Description: On Seiran Island, secret society NLNS is united by Junnosuke Tachibana, who is determined to crush a law. They have found a benefactor, an unknown rich man, who offers them a secret base and cash. Their mission is to locate a mysterious girl and stop the law, keeping the SHO off their trail.

Episodes.Title: Pervert Law
Episodes.Description: Seiran Island, the land of paradise, aka the land of filthy debauchery, where any sexual acts are permitted and enforced by the Pervert Law. Junnosuke, a transfer, is a virgin with pride who despises sex with no love. However, sex is a duty of the island residents! Virginity is a serious crime!! All those who refuse sex will get guillotined by the Future Seiran Homeland Organization (or FS)!!! Junnosuke decides to protect his virginity with his dear life, evading all perverts along with his young virgin sister, Asane. However, they run into Nanase Katagiri, the school's legendary virgin hunter #$%!*...!

Episodes.Title: Savior
Episodes.Description: Item creation to outsmart the FS, securing every escape route, and Nanase's home cooking that achieves perfect nutrition. With Nanase as their ally, Junnosuke and Masane begin their plan to destroy the perverted ordinance. And on Seiran Island, there were other girls besides them who were also struggling! Hinami Watarai, a virgin who is never propositioned for sex by anyone due to her youthful appearance! Azumi Misaki, a virgin with a terrifying libido, but who doesn't want to show her plump body to others! One day, a major incident befalls Hinami!?

Entries.Description: Welcome back to Elmore, where the laws of reality are a joke, and family life is anything but ordinary. Whether he's battling an evil fast-food empire, facing off against a sentient AI in love with his mom, or trying to stop Banana Joe from wearing pants — Gumball Watterson drags his brother Darwin, sister Anais, and the rest of the town of Elmore along for the ride. With even wilder stories, bigger twists, and surreal humor, the show is so amazing that they had to rename it!

Episodes.Title: The Burger
Episodes.Description: Gumball and Darwin want to find a healthy dinner option for their family because they are hooked on Joyful Burger, but an evil food consortium has monopolized the food industry.

Episodes.Title: The Assistant
Episodes.Description: Feeling unappreciated by her family, Nicole strikes up a friendship with a sympathetic Al. As their relationship intensifies, the Al tries to drive a wedge between Nicole and the other Wattersons.

Episodes.Title: The Distance
Episodes.Description: Gumball must find a way to save his relationship with Darwin after the boys are forced to live in separate rooms.

Episodes.Title: The Thing
Episodes.Description: Richard must retrace the memories of his day in order to figure out what "the thing" is, so Nicole's family dinner with Granny Jo Jo won't be another epic failure.

Episodes.Title: The Butts
Episodes.Description: Gumball must help Principal Brown have body confidence about his butt in order to be allowed to do his poem about butts at the Poetry Recital.

Episodes.Title: The Traffic
Episodes.Description: The Wattersons must get Anais to Daisyland before the park closes for good.

Episodes.Title: The Astrological
Episodes.Description: Gumball and Penny must stay together through the end of the school day to prove that they are meant to be together, despite an astrological prediction Mr. Small has made.

Episodes.Title: The Cheerleader
Episodes.Description: Gumball wants to get Richard on the cheerleading team in order to end their family's generational trauma.

Episodes.Title: The Boring
Episodes.Description: Gumball and Darwin use Molly's time-halting power (because she's so boring) to avoid an after school beatdown by Tina.

Episodes.Title: The Teacher
Episodes.Description: Gumball wants to take down Miss Simian after she punishes him for not respecting his school-provided calculator.

Episodes.Title: The App
Episodes.Description: Gumball and Darwin must stop an evil social media app from turning every kid in Elmore into mindless internet-trend-following drones.

Episodes.Title: The Entrance
Episodes.Description: Gumball and Darwin attempt to make a big impression at the coolest party of the year with the most praise-worthy entrance the world has ever seen.

Episodes.Title: The Letter
Episodes.Description: Darwin wants to get back a love letter he wrote to Carrie before she sees it.

Episodes.Title: The Gut
Episodes.Description: When Anais enlists her dad's help with her science project, Richard's GUT becomes its own brilliant thinking entity, separate from the original Richard we all know, and Anais must choose between the two.

Episodes.Title: The Wrinkle
Episodes.Description: Anais starts aging prematurely due to the stress and pressure of looking out for the rest of her stupid family.

Episodes.Title: The Gourmet
Episodes.Description: After tasting Masami's gourmet, double-truffle mac-n-cheese at lunch, Gumball decides to do whatever it takes to get a full serving of the delicious meal.

Episodes.Title: The Pool
Episodes.Description: In the midst of a heatwave, Richard enlists Gumball, Darwin and Anais to assist him in his mission to jump in the Robinson's newly-installed above ground pool.

Episodes.Title: The Portrait
Episodes.Description: Nicole wants a new family portrait where everyone's entire face is in the photo and they're all smiling.

Episodes.Title: The Climb
Episodes.Description: Gumball must face his demons and overcome an embarrassing incident from his past if he wants to finally summit the dreaded rock-climbing wall in gym class.

Episodes.Title: The Amadain
Episodes.Description: Gumball vows to wear a shell and partake in strange Fitzgerald traditions, in order to help Penny get through a tense family birthday party with ease.

Entries.Title: Clevatess
Entries.Description: One of the Lords of Dark Beasts, Clevatess’s reign shatters when he revives a hero he personally slayed and adopts an orphaned humanoid baby—the last hope to save a dying world. Now bound together, what fate awaits this unlikely trio?

Episodes.Description: Clevatess and Alicia are suddenly attacked by an unexpected opponent.

Entries.Title: Eşref Rüya
Entries.Description: As a child, Eşref fell in love from afar with a girl he called “Rüya” and spent years searching for her, only to become a powerful mafia figure along the way. Meanwhile, Nisan, an idealistic musician, finds herself in grave danger after performing at a wedding held at Eşref’s hotel. Eşref falls for Nisan, unaware that she is both the long-lost Rüya he has been chasing for years and a police informant. Trapped in a whirlwind of love, betrayal, and power struggles, Eşref is forced into a brutal reckoning—both with his criminal empire and his own emotions.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Eşref Rüya tells the story of a young man who is a prisoner of a love whose name he does not know. Çağatay Ulusoy plays the character Eşref, who is reckless, has everything but is a prisoner of a love whose name he does not know, while Demet Özdemir plays Nisan, the young musician who makes Eşref's heart skip a beat.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Nisan, who understands that she is in great danger once again with this incident, looks for ways to escape Çiğdem's games. Eşref cannot help but be carried away by feelings that he is unfamiliar with whenever he comes face to face with Nisan. Nisan's getting closer to Eşref causes alarm bells to ring for both of them. On the other hand, a great surprise awaits İzzet, who is drunk with victory. Eşref, who is preparing to make his enemies experience hell, will also face his new rival on the security front.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: After İzzet’s death, Eşref now faces an even greater enemy. Horrified by everything that’s happened, Nisan prepares to make bold moves beyond her limits in order to finally end the game. Meanwhile, with his plans progressing as intended, Kadir is willing to betray the Yetimler to eliminate Eşref from the picture. On the law enforcement side, Serdar investigates the murder at the hotel and comes face to face with Eşref and the tribe. This tense confrontation—where everything could fall apart at any moment—sets the stage for an impending major conflict. Though Nisan plans to throw Eşref into the fire to save herself, seeing a different side of him pushes her into an unexpected dilemma. Her growing closeness with Eşref is about to land her in serious trouble.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Nimet’s abduction of Nisan and Afra signals that the war between the Yetimler and the tribe is far from over. Despite Serdar’s warnings, Eşref and Nusret continue to make moves that only fuel the fire of revenge between them. Kadir does everything he can to turn the Yetimler against Eşref. Meanwhile, his unexpected encounter with Nisan sparks unfamiliar emotions in Kadir’s heart. Eşref’s bold move to rescue Afra catches Nisan off guard. Now caught in a deep moral dilemma, will Nisan be willing to stain her hands with blood—if it means saving her sister’s life?

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description:
Kadir's appearance as a rival in his deepening relationship with Nisan upsets Eşref's balance.  Meanwhile, when Nisan's closeness to Eşref draws the attention of the Gürdals, Nisan faces the risk of being exposed.

While Eşref is convinced to end his feud with Nusret, a surprise development leads him to burn all ships. Eşref's final move will not only cause him to throw himself into the fire, but also his loved ones. Nisan will make a move that will shake Eşref's heart in order to prevent her secrets from being revealed.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: No description available

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description:
Although Nisan is willing to turn down the opportunity she has for her career for Eşref, bigger surprises await her in the future. When the Yetimler's fight with the tribe begins to disturb the elders of the underworld, an unexpected development occurs for both sides. Meanwhile, Yakup Baba's worsening condition is a sign that there will be radical changes in the Yetimler.

Kadir, who is doing everything he can to prevent Eşref from coming to power, has started to get closer to Nisan. Will Kadir, who is burning with love and lust for power, be able to risk betraying Eşref, who he promised to always stand by his side?

Eşref, who agreed to confront Nusret Ağa at the point where the Orphans are in danger, will cause the balances to change again with a surprise move that will have an impact in the underworld.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Although Nisan is willing to turn down the opportunity she has for her career for Eşref, bigger surprises await her in the future. When the Yetimler's fight with the tribe begins to disturb the elders of the underworld, an unexpected development occurs for both sides. Meanwhile, Yakup Baba's worsening condition is a sign that there will be radical changes in the Yetimler.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description:
While Eşref tries to protect Nisan on one hand, he also tries to find the identity of the person who betrayed her. While Eşref's absence causes the team to raise the alarm, Kadir, who prepared the plot, secretly follows the events.

Çiğdem enters a big impasse with the move she made against Atıf. She is ready to take big risks to continue her game. While suspicions on Kadir increase, she will do her best to hide her betrayal.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Eşref sees with his own eyes that the traitor is Kadir and begins to meticulously plan his next move. Kadir feels that the tension between him and Eşref is increasing and looks for ways to get out of the situation he is in. As Nisan and Eşref continue their turbulent relationship, it will become increasingly difficult to resist the attraction between them. When weapons are drawn against betrayal, those who want to survive will have to act quickly.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: Eşref threatens all his enemies by killing Nusret. Kadir, who understands the seriousness of the situation, feels that his mask is about to fall. When the time comes to confront Eşref, he realizes that this is his last chance to put everything in order.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description:
Although Nisan knows that there is no room for love in Eşref's dangerous world, she cannot help but dream of a future with Eşref. Eşref, on the other hand, is in shock at feeling such intense feelings for someone for the first time since Rüya.

While the ceremony to be held for Eşref's ascension to power is on the agenda of the orphans, Kadir is in danger of being exposed at any moment. Helpless, Kadir will have to take refuge in Çiğdem's insidious plans. Eşref, who is in a great dilemma between his position in the underworld and his relationship with Nisan, will encounter an unexpected development that will turn his decisions upside down.

Episodes.Title: Episode 13
Episodes.Description:
The journey he embarks on with the hope of finding the love of his life leaves him face to face with his greatest test yet.

Kadir, blinded by his ambition for leadership, tries every way to seize control and is determined to crush everyone in his path. His collaboration with Çiğdem drags Nisan and Eşref into a dangerous conflict.

In this great struggle where everything is turned upside down, Eşref fights with all his might to protect his loved ones. In the season finale where blood is shed, betrayal reaches its peak and the entire order is turned upside down, Eşref will face his nightmare while waiting to be reunited with his Dream.

Entries.Title: El Turco
Entries.Description: Balaban, a soldier in the Janissary army, settles in Moena in northern Italy after the Battle of Vienna in 1683 and fights for the rights of the local people.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Gravely wounded in the Battle of Vienna, Janissary Hasan Balaban is saved by a witch in an Italian village. As he recovers, he vows vengeance against oppressive lords—unaware that tragedy is about to strike Moena.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: As Hasan’s bond with Gloria deepens, Moena faces danger from Marco’s advancing army. Gloria must choose between survival and sacrifice, while distant Lady Diana plots moves that will bring Marco and Hasan into deadly conflict.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Hasan and Gloria's love causes tension in Moena as Marco’s army nears. A brutal message from Skelettwolf ends truce talks. To save the village, Hasan devises a violent plan—but it will only work if the town stands with him.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: With war looming, Hasan trains Moena’s villagers for battle. But betrayal from within sparks a deadly ambush, leading to major losses. As Hasan mourns a fallen comrade, the stakes of their rebellion grow painfully clear.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: As Moena burns under siege, Hasan challenges Marco to a duel. Gloria and the villagers fight to survive, while Diana and Marco’s twisted plans unfold. A brutal battle erupts—leaving the rebellion hanging by a thread.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: In a final showdown, Hasan fights to save Gloria from execution. Diana and Marco's wedding becomes a battleground for power, love, and revenge. As destiny unfolds, one truth endures: Hasan and Gloria's love defies death itself.

Entries.Title: Legend of Fuyao
Entries.Description: Meng Fuyao, a woman born from a divine lotus petal. She journeys through the five continents towards the heavens in search of a secret order and to reveal a conspiracy originating from the heavens. In the process, she falls in love with the crown prince Zhangsun Wuji.

Entries.Title: Ice Fantasy
Entries.Description: A century after the war between the Ice and Fire Tribes, Prince Ka Suo of the Ice Tribe becomes king, searching for his missing lover and brother. He uncovers a dark conspiracy within his tribe, unaware that his brother, now the Fire Prince with no memory of his past, is leading the Fire Tribe. As tensions rise, the brothers are forced into a new conflict, this time against each other.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: At his coming-of-age ceremony, reluctant 130-year-old ice prince Ka Suo faces an undesirable future -- as well as a fiery interloper.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Trouble arises during a battle in the Snow Fog Forest, but young Shi has a trick up his sleeve. The Fire King enacts a treacherous plan.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Prince Shi embarks on a potential suicide mission to retrieve the Spirit Devouring Sword. A traitor reveals the Ice Clan's weakness to the Fire King.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: While journeying to the Mortal Kingdom with Shi, Ka Suo has a vision of an apocalyptic future. The Fire King learns the secrets of the ice crystal.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: In search of the crystal leaf, Ka Suo and Li Luo trek to the realm of the Healer Tribe. Yun Da looks for Shi but instead finds a dazed man in a lake.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Reunited with the adult Shi, the gang quests further with a Healer prince in tow. But they soon meet a warrior woman who has a bone to pick with Shi.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: While Ka Suo has a run-in with the Tiger Monster, Li Luo and Luna battle a nasty demon themselves. But the crystal leaf lies with a more sinister foe.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Ka Suo and Li Luo arrive at the ethereal Dream City, where they are soon tasked with retrieving a lord from a mind-bending inner reality.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: As everyone’s dreams intersect, reality becomes nearly impossible to untangle. Li Luo discovers the truth about Xing Jui.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: The Fire King formulates a sinister plot as Ka Suo and Li Luo struggle to escape the dream world. The Dream King’s motives may not be what they seem.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: The Fire Clan targets the Bear Clan while Ka Suo visits the Spirit Clan. Yun Fei feels the effects of the heart-burning fruit he was fed.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: While demonic music mesmerizes the mortals, Ka Suo and Li Luo struggle to find the antidote. Yan Da’s emotions get in the way of her duties.

Episodes.Title: Episode 13
Episodes.Description: A desperate Yan Da makes a sacrifice in order to save Shi. Princess Lan Shang of the Mermaid Tribe gets a bitter taste of mortality.

Episodes.Title: Episode 14
Episodes.Description: Ka Suo races to reach the Predor Mermaid before the Fire Tribe does. But the Fire King has prepared a cruel ordeal for him: a prison of despair.

Episodes.Title: Episode 15
Episodes.Description: Ka Suo remains powerless and despondent as the Fire King assumes control of the Ice King’s body, forcing Shi to take matters into his own hands.

Episodes.Title: Episode 16
Episodes.Description: The Mermaid Saint agrees to help Shi kill the Fire King under one condition, which leads to tensions between Shi, Yan Da and Lan Shang.

Episodes.Title: Episode 17
Episodes.Description: Lian Ji frets over Shi’s involvement with Yan Da. Lan Shang goads Shuo Gang and the Fire King into a duel for her hand in marriage.

Episodes.Title: Episode 18
Episodes.Description: While Lan Shang readies herself for a harrowing wedding day, Ka Suo’s soul journeys to a dark place to retrieve the dangerous Spirit Devouring Sword.

Episodes.Title: Episode 19
Episodes.Description: Ka Suo is horrified to learn he’s possessed by the sword spirit. Meanwhile, his love for Li Luo angers the Ice King.

Episodes.Title: Episode 20
Episodes.Description: As Yan Da infiltrates the City of Bladed Snow to meet Shi, Lian Ji becomes more determined to ensure that he takes the throne.

Episodes.Title: Episode 21
Episodes.Description: The decision of who will be the next Ice King proves difficult as deceit and conflicting prophecies complicate matters.

Episodes.Title: Episode 22
Episodes.Description: While the fight for the throne continues to pit brother against brother, the Head Dreamer has a vision that might foretell the future.

Episodes.Title: Episode 23
Episodes.Description: After Ka Suo is attacked by a strange black fog in the mortal realm, Li Luo is banished from the Ice Clan for failing to protect him.

Episodes.Title: Episode 24
Episodes.Description: Li Luo prepares to leave for the northern border. Shi realizes he may have to choose between his brother and everyone else in his life.

Episodes.Title: Episode 25
Episodes.Description: The Ice Tribe tries to expedite the naming of a new king when it seems they are under attack. Li Luo attempts to sniff out the Fire Tribe's spy.

Episodes.Title: Episode 26
Episodes.Description: Various tribe leaders throw their support behind Ka Suo and Shi. Li Luo stumbles upon the banished She Yin, bringing her one step closer to her goal.

Episodes.Title: Episode 27
Episodes.Description: The battle for the throne commences as Liao Jian challenges Pian Feng, and Lan Shang faces off against Chao Ya.

Episodes.Title: Episode 28
Episodes.Description: The battle for the throne barrels toward its conclusion. Ka Suo learns of a disturbing prophecy that seems to dictate he must win.

Episodes.Title: Episode 29
Episodes.Description: Ka Suo struggles to contrive an outcome of the match in which Shi isn't harmed. Li Luo discovers the secrets of She Yin's past.

Episodes.Title: Episode 30
Episodes.Description: After the battle, Ka Suo and Shi must deal with two very different transformations. Xuan Ta and Xing Jiu look for the traitor among the Ice Tribe.

Episodes.Title: Episode 31
Episodes.Description: Hoping to cure Ka Suo, Li Luo brings the Fallen Oracle to the Ice Tribe. The Fire King blackmails Shi into helping him conquer the three realms.

Episodes.Title: Episode 32
Episodes.Description: Lian Ji's treacherous machinations lead to deadly consequences. Shi prepares for his new role as a leader.

Episodes.Title: Episode 33
Episodes.Description: Shi concocts a plan after the Fire King overwhelms an Ice Tribe outpost with arrows. Li Luo begins to avoid a bewildered Ka Suo.

Episodes.Title: Episode 34
Episodes.Description: Ka Suo wanders into the forest and finds Li Luo transformed. Ka Suo runs off to be alone with Lan Shang, but not everything is as it seems.

Episodes.Title: Episode 35
Episodes.Description: Lan Shang devises an alternative to returning to the ocean. Shi has doubts about his own fitness to be king after an encounter with Yan Da.

Episodes.Title: Episode 36
Episodes.Description: Ka Suo and Li Luo take a stand in order to gain permission to marry. Lan Shang uses the wedding to force Shi into a vulnerable position.

Episodes.Title: Episode 37
Episodes.Description: While Li Luo's soul hangs in the balances, Lan Shang attempts to avoid the consequences of her actions by fleeing Snowblade City.

Episodes.Title: Episode 38
Episodes.Description: Shuo Gang reveals the truth about Shi to Ka Suo, who refuses to believe it. A new war between fire and ice may be on the horizon.

Episodes.Title: Episode 39
Episodes.Description: Ka Suo tries to appeal to Shi as the latter makes moves to rescue his mother and Shuo Gang. The Mermaid Saint aims to get her revenge.

Episodes.Title: Episode 40
Episodes.Description: The new Ice King uses his considerable power to restore the Ice Curtain. Lian Ji regains memories of a past she shared with the black fog.

Episodes.Title: Episode 41
Episodes.Description: Ka Suo becomes determined to solve the mystery of the ancient god. The Ice Queen springs into action after a mysterious whirlpool appears.

Episodes.Title: Episode 42
Episodes.Description: Ka Suo and Xing Jiu plan to take the fight with the ancient god to Sacred Snow Mountain, a dangerous place where magic is born.

Episodes.Title: Episode 43
Episodes.Description: At the start of a truly mettle-testing journey, the group faces a daunting challenge from the High Priest.

Episodes.Title: Episode 44
Episodes.Description: Yan Da encounters a startlingly familiar sword fairy. The group faces the first of four guardians on Sacred Snow Mountain.

Episodes.Title: Episode 45
Episodes.Description: The group encounters a guardian who prefers to take an uncommon approach. Yan Da strikes a deal with Shi's soul.

Episodes.Title: Episode 46
Episodes.Description: Ka Suo finds himself enchanted by the deceptively beautiful Southern Guardian. Chao Ya wishes to return to the Spirit Land.

Episodes.Title: Episode 47
Episodes.Description: As the group continues to battle the powerful musician Die Che, Yan Da meets with another guardian -- as well as Yuan Ji himself.

Episodes.Title: Episode 48
Episodes.Description: After encountering the evil Northern Guardian at Lightning Altar, Xing Gui finds herself in a crucial role. The group travels to the Mortal Kingdom.

Episodes.Title: Episode 49
Episodes.Description: Xing Gui aids the group via the dream world. Driven by their shared love for Chao Ya, Liao Jian and Pian Feng form a strong bond.

Episodes.Title: Episode 50
Episodes.Description: Ka Suo and Chao Ya attempt to lure the West Guardian out from the shadows, but the group is shocked by what they uncover.

Episodes.Title: Episode 51
Episodes.Description: The group faces the daunting task of battling Yuan Ji. But a rift between the all-powerful god and Hidden Lotus may give them a fighting chance.

Episodes.Title: Episode 52
Episodes.Description: The resurrected and transformed Shi craves revenge against Ka Suo. Li Luo and Lan Shang struggle with their new identities.

Episodes.Title: Episode 53
Episodes.Description: As a frustrated Li Luo struggles with her amnesia, a new clan from Spirit Snow Mountain arrives at Ren Xue City.

Episodes.Title: Episode 54
Episodes.Description: Ka Suo becomes determined to make Li Luo remember him. Shi conspires to align the Mermaid Tribe with the Fire Tribe.

Episodes.Title: Episode 55
Episodes.Description: A treacherous Shi returns to Snowblade City to manipulate Ka Suo, who grows increasingly concerned about Li Luo.

Episodes.Title: Episode 56
Episodes.Description: Yan Da raises the possibility to her soul-hungry father of a traitor among the Fire Tribe. Chao Ya faces a formidable challenge.

Episodes.Title: Episode 57
Episodes.Description: Ka Suo faces the prospect of war if he doesn't deliver Lan Shang to the Fire King, forcing him to make a difficult decision.

Episodes.Title: Episode 58
Episodes.Description: While confronting Phoenix and the Fire King, Xing Jiu soon finds himself plunged into the dark realm of the Despair Fire Kingdom.

Episodes.Title: Episode 59
Episodes.Description: Ka Suo must confront Shi in the realm of the Fire Tribe after his brother kidnaps Li Luo and Lan Shang.

Episodes.Title: Episode 60
Episodes.Description: With Ka Suo conveniently out of the way, the Fire King launches an attack on Snowblade City. Meanwhile, Yan Da uncovers her father’s secrets.

Episodes.Title: Episode 61
Episodes.Description: While the completely unhinged Fire King goes on a rampage, Ka Suo has little time to let the Hidden Lotus know his final decision.

Episodes.Title: Episode 62
Episodes.Description: The future of the Ice Tribe and many lives depend on a final battle between brothers Ka Suo and Shi.
